name: storeforge-engine
description: Modern Next.js & NestJS Multi-Theme Production E-Commerce Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend" "npm run dev --workspace=admin"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend && npm run build --workspace=admin
scripts.start:all: concurrently "npm run start:prod --workspace=backend" "npm run start --workspace=frontend" "npm run start --workspace=admin"
scripts.prisma:generate: node -e "require('dotenv').config({path:'.env'}); require('child_process').execSync('npx prisma generate --schema=backend/prisma/schema.prisma', {stdio:'inherit', env: process.env})"
scripts.prisma:migrate: node -e "require('dotenv').config({path:'.env'}); require('child_process').execSync('npx prisma migrate dev --schema=backend/prisma/schema.prisma', {stdio:'inherit', env: process.env})"
scripts.prisma:push: node -e "require('dotenv').config({path:'.env'}); require('child_process').execSync('npx prisma db push --schema=backend/prisma/schema.prisma', {stdio:'inherit', env: process.env})"
scripts.prisma:reset: node -e "require('dotenv').config({path:'.env'}); require('child_process').execSync('npx prisma db push --force-reset --schema=backend/prisma/schema.prisma', {stdio:'inherit', env: process.env})"
scripts.prisma:seed: node -e "require('dotenv').config({path:'.env'}); require('child_process').execSync('npx ts-node backend/prisma/seed.ts', {stdio:'inherit', env: process.env})"
